The change that made the configured value take effect is commit `4cc27d388fb4a4fe49316791a20127dbb04e31ae` (PR #1920, by Nethmi Rodrigo, 2026-10-02). It passes `chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest` to the login location picker and removes the unused `chooseLocation.numberToShow`.

The line that passes it to the picker is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx:181`, which sets `locationsPerRequest={Math.max(chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest, 1)}` on `<LocationPicker>`.

Supporting evidence:
- The picker itself still defaults to 50 (`locationsPerRequest = 50` at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:27`), and it uses the value for both the page size and the infinite-scroll trigger (line 68). Before the fix, the login view never passed a value, so the default of 50 always applied.
- The config schema defines the `locationsPerRequest` setting (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/config-schema.ts:44`, type at line 166).
- The changeset entry describes the fix (`openmrs-esm-core/.changeset/login-locations-per-request.md:5`).
- Tests cover the pass-through and the zero-to-1 fallback (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker.test.tsx:435-457`).

Falkon initially rejected the `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core` name in the grep call, so I used the full name for the later calls. The commit was found by message search, and I did not check the diff itself.
